title: SSP-7.1b — Set Publishable Evidence
summary: prove exact checked-document publishability control for public parent and child collections with one atomic rebuild and no Publish change
content_html:
SSP-7.1b — Set Publishable Evidence

Outcome

SSP-7.1b is complete. Set Publishable… now appears on the parent Index and default sub-scope selection surfaces only when their exact configured collection participates in a public projection. It changes the next-Publish inclusion gate for every exact checked document and does not invoke or alter scope-wide Publish.

Contract Proved

  • The parent request is exactly {scope, doc_ids, publishable, confirm}; the child request additionally owns exact sub_scope. Blank, padded, duplicate, missing, unavailable, local, or extra targets fail before mutation.
  • The modal shows the exact checked count, requires Include in next Publish or Exclude from next Publish, and retains OK and Cancel.
  • Include removes explicit publishable: false; Exclude writes only publishable: false. Already-matching rows remain unchanged and an all-no-op selection performs no write, rebuild, recent-edit advance, or activity entry.
  • Every checked source is resolved before the write boundary. Changed sources are committed through one existing snapshot-checked atomic parent or child rebuild; stale snapshots fail before mutation and rebuild failure restores the complete changed selection.
  • Parent and sub-scope UI refreshes return to the exact collection. Local surfaces omit the action. Existing Excluded from next Publish markers remain unchanged.

Verification

  • Focused Set Publishable service matrix: 9 passed, covering parent/child selection, mixed/no-op values, strict requests, local rejection, stale snapshots, rollback, and route status.
  • Related mutation, metadata, create, source-model, and public-runtime boundary regression set: 85 passed in total with the new matrix.
  • Pure browser evidence passes for exact modal copy and payload, one/several selection behavior, response agreement, duplicate rejection, public/local control state, Index rendering, exact child target and refresh handoff, local omission, and retained child exclusion marker.
  • The existing management-service shell passes with the retired publishability routes still returning 404. Focused JavaScript/Python lint and git diff --check pass.

Independent Boundary Review

The diff uses the existing action registry, parent and sub-scope selection owners, management client/service routing, configured public capability, source-model writer, and atomic rebuild boundaries. It adds no metadata fallback, local discovery field, generic batch engine, per-document Publish, public runtime mutation, lineage table, New/Replace choice, diff, merge, or synchronization. The scope-wide Publish endpoint and workflow are unchanged.

Stop for review before SSP-7.2.
